model.name: Stamped tennis ratings
model.how: An Elo rating for every player from all tour-level singles results since January 2025: beat a strong player and the rating rises more. The gap between two ratings gives the win chance.
model.test: Scored on 4967 tour matches in 2026 between players with 20+ matches on file, each predicted before it was played: the higher-rated player won 62% (the ratings expected 62%); players rated 70% or better won 77% of 938 (expected 77%).
